description: Entry point for a vague natural-language repair need you will answer, e.g. "my T490 battery is dying". Use search_parts instead for keyword/exploratory browsing without committing to one clarifying question. Use get_part instead for an exact OEM part number. Use get_model_parts instead when you already have a model slug. A part number in query returns status resolved with that part and next = get_part_fits (type ignored). Otherwise type, if given, overrides any type word in query; else the type word is used; the rest must name one model. resolved: the model, candidate_count, first 10 candidates (compact), and next = get_model_parts with model and type (asks which part if type is missing). needs_clarification: ONE clarifying_question to ask instead of guessing (5G vs Wi-Fi, Intel vs AMD, generation, touch), up to 40 candidate models, next = retry with the chosen slug. not_found has fit_status no_documented_fit (no document, not incompatibility); did_you_mean offers a spelling fix to retry, never auto-applied.

query.description: Required. The user's words (max 200 characters): a model plus part, or an OEM part number with or without dashes, e.g. "T490 battery", "surface pro 11 screen", "L40094001", "01FR025".

type.description: Optional part type, case-insensitive, as listed by get_coverage, e.g. "Battery", "Screen", "Keyboard", "Power Adapter", "SSD", "Memory". Overrides a type word in query; omit it to use the type word, or to be asked which part.

name: resolve_request

fit_status.description: no_documented_fit: there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible. not_asserted: a did-you-mean suggestion; no fit claim is made.

outcome.description: Always present. One field to branch on for every tool: found | no_documented_fit (identified, but no OEM-documented fit; never means incompatible) | needs_clarification (ask the user; see clarifying_question/candidates) | not_found (nothing LPF covers matches). Full contract: /api/states

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

title: Resolve a vague part request
